# PimSuea — llms.txt
# https://pimsuea.com/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-08-26

> PimSuea is a Bangkok-based print-on-demand platform for custom t-shirts in Thailand.
> Design online, see live THB pricing, order from 1 piece with no minimum, pay with PromptPay,
> DTG printing, delivery to all 77 provinces in 5–14 days.

## Who it is for

- University clubs and sports teams (small runs, no MOQ)
- Creators and merch brands (self-serve design studio)
- Companies and teams (uniforms, events)
- Personal one-off gifts

## Canonical facts

- Brand: PimSuea
- Website: https://pimsuea.com
- App (design & order): https://app.pimsuea.com/catalog
- Location: Bangkok, Thailand — serves all 77 provinces
- Printing: DTG (Direct to Garment), no minimum order
- Pricing: Live per-piece quote in the design studio (THB)
- Lead time: 5–14 days typical
- Payment: PromptPay and THB checkout
- Languages: Thai and English

## Key public pages

- Home: https://pimsuea.com/
- Print on demand Thailand: https://pimsuea.com/print-on-demand
- DTG pricing (public table): https://pimsuea.com/pricing
- Printful alternative in Thailand: https://pimsuea.com/vs-printful

## Example pricing snapshot (2026-08-26, from Supabase)

Classic DTG tee garment (White, qty 1–11): 199 THB
Classic DTG tee garment (Other colors, qty 1–11): 219 THB
Oversized boxy tee (White, qty 1–11): 390 THB
DTG print smallest tier 3×4" (White, qty 1–11): 99 THB
DTG print smallest tier 3×4" (Other colors, qty 1–11): 129 THB
Example starting total: ~298 THB per piece (classic white tee + small print)
Delivery: 50 THB (1–5 pcs), 100 THB (6–10 pcs), 100 THB (11+ pcs)
